title: Custom GLSL
subtitle: Raw GLSL expression (base64 encoded)
notes: customExpr node allows raw GLSL stored as base64. The 'glsl' field decodes to a vec4(dist, r, g, b) expression. Use 'p' for position, 'u_time' for animation. Encode with: echo -n 'vec4(...)' | base64
